bundles.title: Coconut Bar Soap — 12-Pack
bundles.story: Buy 8, get 4 free — $88 for twelve bars, $7.33/bar against $11 single and $9.75 in the 4-pack. A one-time stock-up, NOT a subscription vehicle: twelve bars is ~300 days at the merchant's 25-day consumption rate, so it forward-buys the year instead of setting a cadence — the 4-pack stays the subscription SKU and at a 23% per-bar gap it survives alongside this. Priced off the free-portion frame rather than a percent: compareAtPrice is 12 × $11, so the saving reads as four free bars and the $11 anchor is never restated as $7.33. Contribution $41.33 = 1.65× the $25 CAC, so it clears breakeven but NOT the 2× scale gate, which needs $97 — email and organic first, paid only if repriced. Published 2026-08-25 ahead of the giveaway close (operator decision, 2026-08-25) so a test campaign has a buyable page. The prize-devaluation risk of selling discounted soap during the giveaway entry period was raised and accepted; the separate ad-account risk is that the giveaway campaign is still running, so any 12-pack ad set must not be read as if it ran in a quiet account.

bundles.title: Coconut Body Lotion — 4-Pack
bundles.story: The depth play for the hero SKU. Lotion is 72% of revenue and has the largest repeat cohort (417 first-time buyers, 20.6% repurchase), yet it was the only repeat-purchase category with no quantity offer — soap, deodorant and toothpaste all had one. Priced as buy-3-get-1 ($90 against a $120 list) rather than '25% off': identical arithmetic, and the free-portion framing is the one the offer playbook prefers. One bottle is one month (config/consumption-rates.json, merchant-corrected 2026-08-30), so four bottles is a season — that is the quantity argument, and it is measured rather than invented. Built as the intended default tier for paid traffic: at ~$53 contribution it is the only lotion offer whose max CPC reaches the $0.59 actually being paid. TWO SCENTS ONLY, per the two-scent rule in lib/bundle-roster.js — Lavender & Rose has the deepest stock (28 units) and is deliberately ineligible; this bundle is the demand test that rule says it is waiting for. Ships as DRAFT: inventory supports only ~9 packs (Pure Unscented 20 + Coconut Breeze 18), about three weeks at $50/day, so stock has to be ordered before this backs a campaign. templateSuffix is null (default PDP, hide_variants: true) and must move to scoped-gallery if images carrying #scent_ alt tokens are ever added — see the deodorant 4-pack's story for what that mistake costs.
